recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not reintroduce the 2018 Informative/draft warning unless FHIR-I or FMG makes a new decision to reverse NDJSON or bulk-format normative status.
issue_request: FHIR-16425 asked that the Bulk Data Formats subsection on the Normative Formats page be flagged Informative because the subsection text indicated the bulk formats were not intended to be normative. Jira status is Published with resolution Persuasive and applied version STU3.
initial_application: The Jira comments point to svn revision 14248. The corresponding git-svn commit c186eb68d4e1ad666db113ba8611651919b0ce38 mentioned GF#16425 and GF#16997 and wrapped the Bulk Data Formats subsection in draft-content with a warning that the bulk use formats were draft pending further experience. The later FHIR-18448 formats-page split moved the material into source/resource-formats.html while preserving that draft warning at the time.
additional_context: FHIR-16997 is the same 2018 change family and is already represented on the combined branch by no-change audit commit 6f08e4cb1b25fbfc740224cb8a36f369e8eb3cce. FHIR-16500 confirms the 2018 NDJSON page was meant to be STU/non-normative then, while FHIR-31425 later confirms nd-json.html remains an active current-build artifact. R6 commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd removed the draft-content warning from resource-formats.html and changed nd-json.html from Draft to Normative, and FHIR-I 2025-09 WGM minutes state "JSON, NDJSON (already normative)" during R6 review.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing an Informative or draft marker would undo a later R6 normative-status decision rather than complete the original STU3 issue.
